title: Smart Data Models - MTConnect - File
description: AbstractFile type that provides information about the File instance and its URL. (MTConnect 2.8, SysML model class File; JSON Schema MTConnectAssets_2.8.schema.json; property names kept verbatim, deprecated properties and codes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity, urn:ngsi-ld:File:<...>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'File'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

assetId.description: Property. Model:'https://model.mtconnect.org/Version2.8/AssetInformationModel/Files/File/#assetId'. Unique identifier for an Asset.

deviceUuid.description: Property. Model:'https://model.mtconnect.org/Version2.8/AssetInformationModel/Files/File/#deviceUuid'. Associated piece of equipment's UUID that supplied the Asset's data. It references to Device::uuid defined in Device Information Model.

removed.description: Property. Model:'https://model.mtconnect.org/Version2.8/AssetInformationModel/Files/File/#removed'. Indicator that the Asset has been removed from the piece of equipment.

timestamp.description: Property. Model:'https://model.mtconnect.org/Version2.8/AssetInformationModel/Files/File/#timestamp'. Time the Asset data was last modified.

hash.description: Property. Model:'https://model.mtconnect.org/Version2.8/AssetInformationModel/Files/File/#hash'. Condensed message digest from a secure one-way hash function. FIPS PUB 180-4

mediaType.description: Property. Model:'https://model.mtconnect.org/Version2.8/AssetInformationModel/Files/File/#mediaType'. Mime type of the file.

applicationCategory.description: Property. Model:'https://model.mtconnect.org/Version2.8/AssetInformationModel/Files/File/#applicationCategory'. Category of application that will use this file.

applicationType.description: Property. Model:'https://model.mtconnect.org/Version2.8/AssetInformationModel/Files/File/#applicationType'. Type of application that will use this file.

size.description: Property. Model:'https://model.mtconnect.org/Version2.8/AssetInformationModel/Files/File/#size'. Size of the file in bytes. Units:'byte'

versionId.description: Property. Model:'https://model.mtconnect.org/Version2.8/AssetInformationModel/Files/File/#versionId'. Version identifier of the file.

Signature.description: Property. Model:'https://model.mtconnect.org/Version2.8/AssetInformationModel/Files/File/#Signature'. Secure hash of the file.

PublicKey.description: Property. Model:'https://model.mtconnect.org/Version2.8/AssetInformationModel/Files/File/#PublicKey'. Public key used to verify the signature.

CreationTime.description: Property. Model:'https://model.mtconnect.org/Version2.8/AssetInformationModel/Files/File/#CreationTime'. Time the file was created.

ModificationTime.description: Property. Model:'https://model.mtconnect.org/Version2.8/AssetInformationModel/Files/File/#ModificationTime'. Time the file was modified.

FileLocation.description: Property. Model:'https://model.mtconnect.org/Version2.8/AssetInformationModel/Files/FileLocation/'. URL reference to the file location.

Destinations.description: Property. Model:'https://model.mtconnect.org/Version2.8/AssetInformationModel/Files/File/#hasDestination'. Destination entities: target Devices for this File.

FileProperties.description: Property. Model:'https://model.mtconnect.org/Version2.8/AssetInformationModel/Files/AbstractFile/#hasFileProperty'. FileProperty entities: key-value metadata about the File.

FileComments.description: Property. Model:'https://model.mtconnect.org/Version2.8/AssetInformationModel/Files/AbstractFile/#hasFileComment'. FileComment entities: remarks for human interpretation associated with the File.

isAssetOf.description: Relationship. Model:'https://model.mtconnect.org/Version2.8/AssetInformationModel/Asset/#isAssetOf'. Device that supplied the data of this Asset (the Device whose uuid is deviceUuid). Reference to a Device entity.

FileLocation.description: URL reference to the file location.

href.description: URL reference to the file. href is of type xlink:href from the W3C XLink specification.

xlink:type.description: Type of href for the xlink href type. MUST be locator referring to a URL .

Destination.description: Reference to the target Device for this File.

deviceUuid.description: Uuid of the target device or application.

FileProperty.description: Key-value pair providing additional metadata about a File.

FileComment.description: Remark or interpretation for human interpretation associated with a File or FileArchetype.

value.description: Text of the comment about the file.
